segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ רַבִּי יִשְׁמָעֵאל אוֹמֵר: שָׁלֹשׁ אֲבָנִים זוֹ בְּצַד זוֹ בְּצַד מַרְקוּלִיס — אֲסוּרוֹת, וּשְׁתַּיִם — מוּתָּרוֹת. וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: שֶׁנִּרְאוֹת עִמּוֹ — אֲסוּרוֹת, וְשֶׁאֵין נִרְאוֹת עִמּוֹ — מוּתָּרוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «Rabbi Yishmael says: Three stones» that are «adjacent to each other at» the «side of Mercury [Markulis] are prohibited,» as that idol was worshipped by tossing stones toward it, which then became part of the idol. «But» if there are only «two» stones, then they «are permitted. And the Rabbis say:» Those stones «that are adjacent to» Mercury and appear to have fallen from it «are prohibited. But» those stones «that are not adjacent to it are permitted.»

moves.about: which stones near a Markulis are forbidden: three adjacent ones, or those that appear to belong to it

edges.about: which stones near a Markulis are forbidden: three adjacent ones, or those that appear to belong to it

positions.claim: three adjacent stones are forbidden, two are permitted
stones that appear with it are forbidden, others permitted
